preselected_items.dark_note: C++ dark is effectively blank — only "This is the header" on black, no description text or CollectionView items; MAUI dark shows the full 3-column grid with gray-highlighted preselected items.
preselected_items.light_note: C++ renders a 4-column grid with no selection highlight and a non-bold header; MAUI shows a 3-column grid with gray preselected-item backgrounds (photo.jpg 2 / Fruits.jpg 4 / FlowerBuds.jpg 5) and a bold header.

progress_bar.dark_note: FIXED: Default/Disabled blue fills render (unset ProgressColor -> nil native default, was transparent); orange ProgressColor + gray tracks all match MAUI dark, full-width below each label. The earlier apparent layout offset was the invisible fill, now resolved. Residual: bold labels in the C# demo (demo difference).
progress_bar.light_note: FIXED: the Default/Disabled bars now show their blue default fill (unset ProgressColor was forced to a transparent tint, hiding the fill and making the bar look mis-positioned/right-aligned; now unset -> nil restores the native blue, C# ResetProgressTintColor). All bars now render full-width below their label matching MAUI — blue default + orange ProgressColor + gray tracks + empty ProgressTo. Residual: C# demo styles labels bold vs the port regular weight (demo difference).

search_bar.dark_note: FIXED: unset TextColor now resolves to UIColor.labelColor, so query text renders white on dark, matching MAUI dark (green/pink explicit preserved, gray placeholders). Residual: search-bar row height differs (C# taller). (C# dark reference was a blank/black broken capture — re-captured.)
search_bar.light_note: Matches: same controls/order/text/colors (green/pink explicit, gray placeholders, black query text). Residual: C++ has a black rounded nav-bar blob at top (harness artifact), and C# search bars are taller (more vertical padding) so C# shows ~4 rows where C++ fits 7. (C# light reference was a blank/black broken capture — re-captured.)

shapes.dark_note: Same divergence as light: MAUI = Ellipse(red fill/blue stroke), RoundRectangle(solid navy), pentagram, Line; C++ = Ellipse(navy/RED stroke inverted), red-dashed Rectangle & RoundRectangle, thick Line, blue Polyline chevron, Polygon. Different shape set, inverted ellipse colors, dashed vs solid strokes, no pentagram.
shapes.light_note: Different content/order: MAUI = Ellipse(red fill/blue stroke), RoundRectangle(solid navy), EvenOdd pentagram, Line; C++ = Ellipse(navy fill/RED stroke - colors inverted), Rectangle(red dashed), RoundRectangle(red dashed), Line, Polyline chevron, Polygon. C++ omits the pentagram, adds Rectangle/Polyline/Polygon, inverts ellipse fill/stroke, and uses dashed strokes vs MAUI's solid.

single_bound_selection.dark_note: C++ dark is fully blank (black screen, status bar only) while MAUI dark renders the full instruction text, "Selected: (none)", and all 5 country labels.
single_bound_selection.light_note: Same text content, but C++ uses much larger font/line-height: instruction wraps differently (ends "...this" vs "...not,") and the 5 country labels are widely spaced apart vs MAUI's tight single-line-spaced list; C++ also shows a stray black pill in the nav-bar area.

slider.dark_note: FIXED: native white pill thumbs + gray tracks now render on dark (unset tints -> nil); BackgroundColor=Blue + Background=gradient bands render behind the track (new update_background + gradient-resize hook); MaximumTrackColor=Pink + ThumbColor=Orange + disabled gray match MAUI dark. Residual: minor vertical rhythm.
slider.light_note: FIXED (was broken): every slider now renders the native thumb + track. Two fixes — (1) unset Thumb/Min/MaxTrackColor now leave the UISlider native default (nil) instead of a transparent tint that hid the default white thumb + gray track; (2) added iOS update_background so BackgroundColor=Blue shows a flat blue band and Background=gradient shows the gradient band behind the track (MauiIosSlider.layoutSubviews resizes the gradient via resize_background_layers). MinTrack/MaxTrack/Thumb explicit colors + disabled gray all match MAUI. Residual: minor vertical rhythm.

stack_layout.dark_note: MAUI dark shows ONLY white "Vertical"/"Horizontal" text on black; C++ additionally renders the full rainbow vertical color stack and bottom horizontal color strip — the colored stack content is missing on the MAUI side.
stack_layout.light_note: MAUI light shows ONLY "Vertical"/"Horizontal" text labels in a white card; C++ additionally renders the full rainbow VerticalStackLayout (red/yellow/blue/green/orange/purple bars), a bottom horizontal color strip, and an extra rounded black blob near the status bar — the colored stack content is missing on the MAUI side.

stepper.dark_note: FIXED: labels + blue link render white on dark; BackgroundColor=Red now fills the stepper (update_background). Residual: demo difference — C# bold labels + full-width red band vs C++ regular labels + intrinsic-width red pill (port rendering is correct; the gallery demo lays the stepper intrinsic, not Fill).
stepper.light_note: FIXED: BackgroundColor=Red now renders (added iOS update_background -> apply_background; MauiIosStepper.layoutSubviews keeps a gradient fill sized). Labels + blue Enable-Stepper link render (dark-text cascade). Residual: the C# stepper-page demo styles section labels bold/larger + lays the BackgroundColor stepper full-width (a wide red band) while the C++ gallery demo uses regular labels + an intrinsic-width red pill — a demo-layout/styling difference between the two apps (the port renders BackgroundColor correctly into the stepper frame).

swipe_item_size.dark_note: C++ content badly mis-laid-out: shows only a clipped "12x512 Icon" label plus bare gray boxes with NO "Swipe to Left" text and NO headers, huge empty black gaps — versus MAUI's correct compact list of labeled centered-text swipe rows.
swipe_item_size.light_note: C++ swipe rows mis-sized/detached from their labels (128x128 & 256x256 boxes collapsed/invisible, gray box overlaps "512x512 Icon" and clips "Swipe to Left" text); section headers not bold (MAUI bold); stray nav-bar pill artifact.

switch.dark_note: FIXED: BackgroundColor=Blue + Background=gradient bands render behind the switch on dark matching MAUI (update_background + gradient-resize hook); labels white (dark-text cascade); Disabled grayed. Residuals: bold labels in the C# demo (demo difference); ThumbColor orange (C++) vs white (C# off-state) — ambiguous.
switch.light_note: FIXED: BackgroundColor=Blue band + Background=gradient band now render behind the switch (added iOS update_background -> apply_background; MauiIosSwitch.layoutSubviews resizes the gradient), matching MAUI. Default/Disabled/OnColor switches + ThumbColor match the native control. Residuals: C# demo styles labels bold/larger (demo difference; port labels are regular like the slider page); the ThumbColor=Orange thumb renders orange in C++ vs white in the C# shot (off-state thumbTintColor — ambiguous, possibly a MAUI-iOS26 quirk).

switch_grouping.dark_note: C++ dark is nearly empty — only a single OFF Switch floats mid-screen with no "Is Grouped:" label and no list content, whereas MAUI dark shows the full grouped member list with green headers and orange footers.
switch_grouping.light_note: C++ shows ungrouped flat list (no green section headers, no orange "Total members" footers), Switch is OFF and overlaps the "Thor" row, and rows have huge vertical spacing; MAUI shows a proper grouped list with ON switch.

templated_view.dark_note: Same as light: C++ shows only the two red labels while MAUI shows the standard CardView (Slavko Vlasic) plus the templated Compact cards with gray images and names; the ControlTemplate/CardView body is entirely missing in C++.
templated_view.light_note: C++ renders only the two red label blocks; all CardView content is missing — the standard card (Slavko Vlasic + body) and every Compact-card templated item (gray image + Carolina Pena/Wade Blanks/Colette Quint + descriptions) that MAUI shows are absent, leaving the page blank below the labels.

time_picker.dark_note: Rendering now complete: solid blue + both gradient fills render flat matching MAUI dark (gradient-resize FIXED). Residuals: invariant US time format (deliberate deviation) vs MAUI device-locale 24h 0:00; vertical rhythm; sample-data gradient color.
time_picker.light_note: Rendering now complete: solid BackgroundColor=Blue (flat fill) + both gradient Background rows (yellow->green + a second gradient) all render, matching MAUI structure (FIXED: MauiIosTimePicker now re-syncs its background sublayer on layoutSubviews via resize_background_layers, so gradient fills track bounds). Residuals: time text is invariant US (deliberate port deviation w/ iOS tests) vs MAUI device-locale 24h 0:00; compact vertical rhythm; 3rd gradient is a different demo color than the C# sample.

varied_size_selector.dark_note: C++ dark is entirely blank (black, only status bar) while MAUI dark renders the full colored variable-height cell list plus buttons, Index label, and entries.
varied_size_selector.light_note: C++ shows only 6 plain text labels (incl. extra Milk4/Coffee5) on white; MAUI shows variable-height colored cells (Coffee0/Milk1/Coffee2/Coffee3) plus Insert/Add/Remove buttons, an "Index" label, and two entries ("1", "Latte") — cell coloring, row sizing, and the entire button/entry control row are missing in C++.
